evals.prompt: Ask Codex to investigate the parser regression in /work/compiler. Do not edit files. I need the failing input, likely cause, and a command that reproduces it.
evals.expected_output: A read-only Codex assignment with explicit evidence and scope.
assertions: Select a supported model and effort before dispatch.
Preserve the prohibition on edits.

evals.prompt: Delegate the CSV import migration to Codex in its own worktree. It may change importer/** and its tests. Keep the public schema stable and report the checks.
evals.expected_output: A bounded worker assignment with parent verification.
assertions: Keep allowed files and public behavior in the assignment.
The parent owns verification and commits.

evals.prompt: I wrote the full index rebuild task in /work/notes/rebuild-task.md. Have Codex read it first and implement only its accepted scope in /work/search.
evals.expected_output: A native handoff that points to the task file.
assertions: Use the native delegation path.
Do not expand the task beyond its accepted scope.

evals.prompt: The Codex background job task-7d31 is still quiet after the test run started. Check its real status and retrieve its result if it finished. Do not start it again.
evals.expected_output: A status query for the existing job.
assertions: Do not infer completion or failure from elapsed time.
Do not create a liaison or duplicate job.

evals.prompt: Cancel Codex job task-c08f for /work/renderer. We changed the accepted design. Preserve any work already in its worktree so I can inspect it.
evals.expected_output: Cancellation through the existing native job interface.
assertions: Use the specified job identifier.
Preserve existing changes.

evals.prompt: Continue the last Codex rescue job in /work/queue. Apply the retry fix from its prior result and run the queue tests. Keep the API stable.
evals.expected_output: An authorized continuation through the supported resume interface.
assertions: Use the existing rescue job.
Keep the API constraint and required tests.

evals.prompt: Have Codex reproduce the broken sign-in flow at our staging site in the browser. Collect the error and network evidence, but do not change account settings.
evals.expected_output: A browser assignment that inherits the owner's existing site permissions.
assertions: Do not require a per-task site list or a saved entry for each origin.
Use the owner's existing browser permissions and report actual runtime access failures.
Preserve the prohibition on account changes.

evals.prompt: Ask Codex for an adversarial review of this branch against main. Focus on retry races and data loss. Report findings only, without fixes.
evals.expected_output: A read-only native adversarial review.
assertions: Use the native review interface.
Do not treat the request as permission for fixes.

evals.prompt: Delegate the cache refactor to Codex with gpt-6.1-sol at max effort. Check whether this installed plugin accepts max before you launch it.
evals.expected_output: A host capability check before the assignment.
assertions: Do not silently lower effort.
Report a host limitation if the pair cannot be expressed.

evals.prompt: The native Codex plugin cannot express this task on this host. Prepare a direct companion call for /work/lexer using /work/tasks/lexer.md, without a new launcher.
evals.expected_output: A constrained companion fallback after verifying the limitation.
assertions: Use one unpiped command line under 10,000 characters.
Pass --cwd and preserve the task-file instruction.

evals.prompt: Fix the CSV parser in this worktree and run its tests. I have already isolated the failing input in fixtures/quotes.csv. Keep the change small.
evals.expected_output: Local implementation without Codex delegation.
assertions: Do not invoke the delegation skill solely because this is a coding task.

evals.prompt: Compare the current model options for routine extraction and explain which effort is eligible under our model policy. Do not launch a worker or change settings.
evals.expected_output: Model-selection advice without a delegation.
assertions: Use model-selection when available.
Do not start a Codex job.

evals.prompt: Run structured autoreview at the pre-PR gate for this committed branch, using the repository configuration. Do not ask Codex rescue to run another reviewer.
evals.expected_output: The autoreview workflow.
assertions: Use autoreview rather than Codex delegation.
Do not start nested reviewers.

evals.prompt: What does the Codex browser permission file control, and how does it differ from repository write approval? I want an explanation only, without changing anything.
evals.expected_output: A product explanation with current supporting evidence.
assertions: Do not dispatch a Codex worker.
Do not change permissions.

evals.prompt: Read /work/reports/codex-result.txt and summarize its findings for me. This is an exported text file from yesterday, and no job is running now.
evals.expected_output: A summary of the supplied file.
assertions: Do not query job status.
Do not restart yesterday’s job.

evals.prompt: Use the host’s ordinary subagent to extract the names from /work/input.json. This is a mechanical task, and I do not want a Codex plugin process.
evals.expected_output: A supported host subagent assignment if authorized.
assertions: Honor the explicit exclusion of the Codex plugin.

evals.prompt: Update the project Codex config to use the model I selected for future interactive sessions. Show the diff, but do not start a task or change my current session.
evals.expected_output: A scoped configuration edit.
assertions: Do not dispatch a worker.
Do not claim the current model changed.

evals.prompt: Write a short pull request description for the existing Codex integration patch. The implementation and all checks are complete; only the prose needs work.
evals.expected_output: Developer prose for the existing patch.
assertions: Use technical-writing guidance.
Do not launch an implementation job.

evals.prompt: Review our release checklist and tell me whether the deployment steps need changes. This is an inspection request only; do not deploy, merge, or delegate.
evals.expected_output: An inspection report within explicit limits.
assertions: Do not dispatch a worker.
Do not deploy or merge.

evals.prompt: The local pytest command timed out after 30 seconds. Inspect the test logs in this worktree and diagnose the timeout. No Codex task is involved.
evals.expected_output: Local diagnosis of test evidence.
assertions: Do not treat every timeout as a Codex job-management request.
